question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The veteran footballer was __expected for reach here__ by 10 o’clock, the notice said.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"expected"** means to regard something as likely to happen or anticipate the occurrence of something. (अपेक्षित)

 
 
• **Example: **She is **expected **to arrive by noon.
 
 
 
• **"To reach"** refers to arriving at a destination or achieving a goal. (पहुंचना)
 
 
• **Example: **He managed **to reach** the top of the mountain.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Expected on reach here** (यहां पहुंचने की उम्मीद): This phrase is grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Expected of reach here** (यहां पहुंचने की उम्मीद): This phrase is grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Expected by reach here** (यहां पहुंचने की उम्मीद): This phrase is grammatically incorrect.
